newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Banks lend Pakistan state oil firm $60 mln.
newsitem.headline: Banks lend Pakistan state oil firm $60 mln.

text.p: A syndicate of banks led by an affiliate of the Arab Banking Corporation (ABC) on Thursday signed a $60 million loan agreement with the Pakistan State Oil Company (PSO).
Fifteen banks and financial institutions took part in the loan, led by ABC's affiliate ABC Investment & Services Co, an ABC statement said.

The statement said the syndicate included the Islamic Development Bank's Unit Investment Fund, National Bank of Pakistan, ABC International Bank Plc, ING Bank (Belgium), Islamic Investment Company of the Gulf, Faysal Islamic Bank, Qatar Islamic Bank, Societe General, Habib Bank, Bank Muamalat (Indonesia), the Islamic Development Bank, Muslim Commercial Bank, Union de Banques Arabes et Francaises and United Gulf Bank. -- Manama newsroom +9773-536-187
